conclusion: The unused-patch concern is closed for the unchanged valid frozen/headless worker install path. A configured ffmpeg patch outside the selected worker closure is not itself an UNUSED_PATCH or per-package patch-application failure. Existing successful noVNC-unselected-patch installation is the same category. No new VM/test is required solely to close this concern; combined installation has not been executed by this review.
reasoning: core/install calculates current patch hashes and compares lockfile settings before frozen install; mismatches still fail rather than being ignored.
A valid explicitly frozen install uses tryFrozenInstall -> headlessInstall and returns before full dependency resolution.
resolve-dependencies only calls verifyPatches when full lockfile reanalysis is required (forceFullResolution or no packages) and all importers are resolved.
verifyPatches uses error code UNUSED_PATCH (singular) only if an unused patch remains and allowUnusedPatches is false/unspecified.
headless filters dependency snapshots to selected importers and their recursive dependencies before graph construction. buildModules applies patches only to actual graph nodes.

The original full workspace policy, both patch files, and lock-level patchedDependencies/hash entries are retained by #1805 projection. Neither three worker importer blocks nor worker package manifests changed in the #1810 ffmpeg patch delta.
boundaries: Do not add allowUnusedPatches or remove patch/lock metadata: neither is required for this path.
This conclusion does not cover non-frozen or forced full resolution, a future worker dependency on ffmpeg, missing/changed patch bytes, or pnpm version changes.
Original noVNC installation counts are existing root/owner execution evidence, not a new test performed here.
